title: dodag.py: Hysteresis can select inadmissible parent
description: Line 250-256: The hysteresis logic fetches `current` from `self.parents` directly without checking if it passes `_admissible()`. When the current preferred parent's path cost exceeds `_lowest_rank + max_rank_increase` (making it inadmissible), but improvement over the best admissible candidate is less than `parent_switch_threshold`, the code selects the inadmissible parent. This violates RFC 6550 MaxRankIncrease constraint (Section 8.2.2.4), which bounds rank growth to prevent routing loops. Failure scenario: Node joins via A (cost 1000), better B appears (cost 300), B disappears, A reselected. A's cost increases to 2400 exceeding threshold 2348. New C appears at cost 2300. Improvement 100 < 192 triggers hysteresis selecting inadmissible A.
